text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: 18.0 to 18.8 s wide street: the white car eases a little to the right in the brown water and stops while the water line climbs from the hubs to cover the wheels and lower doors. Car occupies a small band in the middle of a tall frame; caption sits just below the water band.
